newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady on August barrels.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady on August barrels.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run was largely steady on Thursday with sellers starting to show August barrels after most of this month's material was sold, traders said.
They said sellers were at the $105/$107 mark for 0.5-0.7 pct sulphur August material but little buying interest was seen.
Traders said at least one July cargo, one of the last left, traded this week at around the $103.25 fob mark.

A refiner, one of this week's sellers, said that with Russian high-sulphur E-4 premiums very high at the moment due to its scarcity, low sulphur straight-run was becoming more of a viable alternative to buyers.

On the high-sulphur front, some good quality M-40 was on offer at a handsome three means +$4, and four cargoes of M-100, one Polish and three Russians, were also on the market at a steady two means plus $6.
But traders said that straight-run buyers were holding back at these high levels.
